_note: Sprite cell, character materials and layer draw order. Read by the generator; exported into every atlas so the game never hard-codes any of it.
_cellNote: Ground and shadows use the true 30 degree iso pitch. Characters are drawn at a shallower 12 degrees so faces and chests read, as in concept-05. scale is screen px per unit: 134 units -> about 120 px.

materials._note: Material name used by the generator -> palette ramp. Swap skin and hair entries per race.

slotOrder._note: Within one body segment, slots always stack in this order.

segmentOrder._note: Back to front, per facing. Only S is used at gate 1; the other seven are filled in at gate 2.
